text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key idea is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another important use is sentiment analysis, where computers study text to find out if people feel positive, negative, or neutral about something. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with users and answer their questions in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily interaction with technology is becoming simpler and more human.
